boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten specific Elon spaces for studying, making, meeting, reflecting and connecting, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: Settle In Around the Fireplace
cards.subtitle: Games, organization offices and casual seating inside Moseley Center
cards.notes: Stop by the first-floor Student Center to relax near the fireplace or borrow game equipment from the Moseley front desk.
cards.short_summary: A casual campus hub where students can meet, recharge and play tabletop games between commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon says the Moseley Student Center has student organization offices, ping pong, pool, foosball, shuffleboard, beanbags and fireplace seating; game equipment is available at the front desk.
cards.source_title: About the Center | Moseley Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Game equipment and a Nintendo Switch can be checked out at the Moseley front desk; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Study Beside Elon’s Black Wall of Fame
cards.subtitle: A study, gathering and history space on Moseley Center’s second floor
cards.notes: Use the room for focused work, then spend time with the Wall of Fame tracing Black achievement across Elon’s history.
cards.short_summary: A shared study room that also preserves and presents the accomplishments of Elon’s Black community.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon identifies the Black Community Room as a study area, gathering place, meeting facility and historical archive containing the African American Wall of Fame.
cards.source_title: Second Floor | Moseley Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Located on Moseley Center’s second floor; the university says students, employees and visitors are invited to visit.

cards.entity_name: Asian and Pacific Islander Community Room
cards.title: Bring a Small Study Session to Room 224
cards.subtitle: A quiet community room with cultural publications in Moseley Center
cards.notes: Choose this room for individual or small-group study, and leave time to browse the publications on Asian cultures and heritage.
cards.short_summary: A small-scale study setting paired with resources for learning about Asian and Pacific Islander cultures.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon says the Asian and Pacific Islander Community Room in Moseley 224 supports individual or small-group study and provides publications about Asian culture and heritage.
cards.source_title: Second Floor | Moseley Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Located in Moseley Center Room 224; the university invites students, employees and visitors to visit.

cards.title: Practice Spanish in El Centro’s Living Space
cards.subtitle: A cultural and conversational gathering place in Carlton Building
cards.notes: Check El Centro’s programming before you go, then use its welcoming living space to connect through language and culture.
cards.short_summary: A student-facing center where cultural programming and Spanish conversation share a home base.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon reports that El Centro occupies Carlton Building’s first floor with a living space and kitchen and offers opportunities to learn about Latinx cultures and practice Spanish.
cards.source_title: Reflecting on the past and present of Hispanic Heritage Month at Elon
cards.access_notes: El Centro is in Carlton Building Room 114; consult CREDE for current programs and room availability.

cards.title: Turn a Digital Design Into a Physical Prototype
cards.subtitle: Elon Town Center workspace with fabrication equipment
cards.notes: Review access guidance first, then bring a prepared design for the 3D printers, laser engraver or CNC router.
cards.short_summary: A fabrication-focused workspace suited to prototypes that need digital cutting, engraving or printing tools.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon identifies Maker Hub – Downtown in Elon Town Center as a campus maker location equipped with 3D printers, a laser engraver, a CNC router and additional tools.
cards.source_title: Locations | The Maker Hub | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Review the Maker Hub’s current hours, training requirements and equipment-access guidance before starting a project.

cards.title: Work With Textiles and 3D Printing in Allen Hall
cards.subtitle: A neighborhood maker space in the Colonnades residential area
cards.notes: Bring a textile or 3D-printing idea to the Allen Hall lobby, after checking current training and access requirements.
cards.short_summary: A second maker location emphasizing textile work and 3D-printing projects within a residential neighborhood.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon places Maker Hub – Colonnades in Allen Hall’s lobby and states that it provides tools for 3D-printing and textile projects.
cards.source_title: Locations | The Maker Hub | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Located in Allen Hall’s lobby; verify current hours, building access and required equipment training before visiting.

cards.title: Find a Room for Reflection or Conversation
cards.subtitle: Elon’s multifaith center in Lambert Academic Village
cards.notes: Step inside for quiet reflection, study or dialogue, choosing among the library, study room, meditation room and gathering areas.
cards.short_summary: A multifaith building that supports reflection alongside study, discussion and community gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon describes Numen Lumen Pavilion as a multifaith center containing a Sacred Space, gathering space, prayer room, library, study room, meditation room and classroom.
cards.source_title: Numen Lumen Pavilion | Truitt Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Public hours are Monday–Friday and Sunday, 8 a.m.–9 p.m.; Phoenix Card access extends from 9 p.m. to midnight. Closed Saturday.

cards.title: Pause by the Kugel Ball Fountain
cards.subtitle: An outdoor reflection garden beside Numen Lumen Pavilion
cards.notes: Take a quiet break on a garden bench and notice the Kugel ball fountain before returning to the center of campus.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor counterpart to the multifaith center, designed for seated reflection and scheduled meditation.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon documents a Meditation Garden outside Numen Lumen Pavilion with benches and a Kugel ball fountain; student meditation meetings use the garden when weather permits.
cards.source_title: Numen Lumen Pavilion | Truitt Center | Elon University
cards.access_notes: The garden is outdoors beside Numen Lumen Pavilion; scheduled meditation may move inside during unsuitable weather.

cards.title: Choose a Floor That Fits the Work
cards.subtitle: Research, study and collaboration space on North O’Kelly Avenue
cards.notes: Check the floor maps before arriving, then choose a setting suited to solo research, collaborative work or librarian assistance.
cards.short_summary: Elon’s academic commons combines adaptable study space with collections, technology and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Belk Library states that it provides spaces where people can research, study and collaborate, while its official floor-map page documents three building levels.
cards.source_title: About Us | Carol Grotnes Belk Library | Elon University
cards.access_notes: Located at 308 North O’Kelly Avenue; check the library’s current hours and visitor-parking instructions before arrival.

cards.title: Gather on the Tiered Seats in Founders Hall
cards.subtitle: An open collaboration area at the center of Elon’s engineering building
cards.notes: Use the tiered seating for a project check-in or informal discussion, while keeping scheduled events and classes in mind.
cards.short_summary: A two-story engineering atrium built around flexible collaboration, assembly and small-group meeting space.
cards.evidence_claim: Elon describes the Hunt Atrium in Founders Hall as a two-story space with open collaboration and assembly areas, tiered bench seating and meeting space.
cards.access_notes: Inside Founders Hall; use is subject to current building access, academic activity and scheduled events.
